notes.route: chosen via /hyperframes SKILL.md ambiguity rule: explicit 10s duration -> /motion-graphics (kinetic-type) over /product-launch-video
notes.category_pivot: Started as the search-driven 'webpage' category (live capture of https://example.com via `hyperframes capture`). The sandbox's network egress policy blocks that host (proxy status: 403 CONNECT to example.com:443, policy denial). Per categories/webpage/module.md, a blocked capture with no user-supplied screenshot must stop rather than invent DOM/coordinates, so the Director re-classified to the asset-free 'kinetic-type' category using example.com's well-known, publicly documented purpose (IANA/RFC 2606 reserved example domain) instead of fabricated marketing copy.
notes.gsap_source: GSAP CDN (cdn.jsdelivr.net) is also blocked by the same egress policy; vendored locally at vendor/gsap.min.js (installed via `npm install gsap` from the allowed npm registry) and referenced with a relative <script src>.
